I’m going to concentrate on three areas that materially improve maintainability: strong typing in the field/state model, extraction of simulation population/configuration logic, and consolidation of duplicated animal behavior where it currently hides bugs.

item.text:
Implemented a targeted refactor focused on the simulation core, state model, and initialization flow.

- I replaced the weakly typed field storage with typed `Animal[][]` and `Plant[][]`, and pushed placement/clearing responsibility into the entity hierarchy so `Entity` no longer relies on `instanceof` checks. The main changes are in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Field.java:7), [Entity.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Entity.java:4), [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Animal.java:6), and [Plant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Plant.java:4).
- I extracted population seeding out of `Simulator` into [FieldPopulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/FieldPopulator.java:6), which removes the long initialization chain from [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Simulator.java:6) and centralizes spawn rules and graph color registration.
- I simplified the simulation update flow in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Simulator.java:87) by extracting view updates and sickness percentage calculation, which also fixes the empty-population divide-by-zero case.
- I cleaned up support code in [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/FieldStats.java:5), [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/SimulatorView.java:5), [Location.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Location.java:2), [Gender.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/Gender.java:4), and [TimeCycle.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/TimeCycle.java:2) to remove unused state, improve immutability, and tighten APIs.

This refactor also corrected a few bugs that were embedded in the old shared logic: nocturnal animals were acting during the day, breeding could happen without a mate, and `reset()` was allowing the plant list to accumulate stale entries.

Verified with `javac *.java`. I did not run the Swing UI interactively in this environment.
